treatment: Exclude the whole Manchester-Nashua MSA from the primary longitudinal study, retaining previous holdouts and original source data. No population allocation of PIT/HIC and no replacement with the full Balance of State count.
revisit_condition: Reconsider only if compatible historical county/town PIT and geographically identified HIC inventories support full-MSA coverage. The CoC records remain available for analyses using their documented service areas.

annotation.summary: Manchester-Nashua excluded because documented CoC coverage is below the study threshold
annotation.text: Manchester-Nashua MSA 31700 is excluded from the primary 2010-2024 study (2021 is excluded study-wide). The HUD NH-502 polygon covers Hillsborough County outside Manchester, but historical CoC applications, governance documents and a state CoC map describe Nashua and nine surrounding towns, with the remaining twenty county towns assigned to NH-500 Balance of State. The documented NH-501/NH-502 service areas cover 313,367 of 422,937 residents (74.1%, Census 2020), below both the 95% and 99% MSA coverage thresholds. Compatible historical PIT/HIC for the county's Balance of State portion have not been established; neither population allocation nor inclusion of the entire Balance of State count is appropriate. In 2018, county PIT was 715 versus 708 for the selected pair; that small residual does not establish other years' counts or HIC capacity. Exclusion reflects geographic coverage, not observed study outcomes. Original CoC data are retained; reconsideration requires compatible historical counts and inventories.
